title: A second project runs one item end to end on the plugin's /sprint, and its retrospective findings are kb items
goal: A git project other than the kb installs the plugin, writes its backlog.json (a repositories map when it spans repositories, a docs map, its forge), files or imports its items, and one item is claimed, dispatched to a headless worker, landed and closed by the plugin's sprint skill with the operator present; the retrospective's findings about the tooling are filed as kb bugs or stories under this epic (titles naming the plugin sprint run), each with a repro from that run. This story is the epic's fitness test: the epic is not done while it is open, and it is closed with drop --why naming the run's findings, since its own touches are item files.
